description: French Navy Skyraider preserved at the French air base at Djibouti and repainted in Armee de l'Air markings as 21-LP. Le Fana de l'Aviation reported the restoration. Last noted February 2025.
Former Armee de l'Air Super Sabre preserved on the base wearing code 11-YB. Last noted February 2025. Two further F-100 airframes lie in a scrapyard at Balbala and are deliberately not recorded.

Complete Mirage IIIC preserved on the base. Spottingmode carries the identity with an explicit caveat after a February 2025 contributor could not be certain which of the two Djibouti Mirage IIICs stands at this position; treat the serial as provisional.
Second Djibouti Mirage IIIC surviving as nose section and fin only, a few metres from the preserved Skyraider. Last noted February 2025.
Former Armee de l'Air Mirage F1C-200 preserved on the base wearing code 33-FO. Last noted February 2025.

French civil-registered Beech 18 recorded as preserved in the Djibouti display group. Unlike the five military airframes at this site it carries no recent last-noted date so its continued presence is the least certain of the group.
